env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos build ./...
! stderr 'discarded_error'
cd ..

cd m/a
logos build -o $WORK/a.a .
cd ..
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/a.a __.LOGOS
stdout 'AlwaysNilError'
! stdout '^lang go$'

cd g
logos build -o $WORK/g.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/g.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn AlwaysNil AlwaysNilError$'
stdout '^lang go$'

cd g
go build -o $WORK/g-plain.a .
cd ..
! go tool pack p $WORK/g-plain.a __.LOGOS

cp bad.txt m/a/a.lgo
cd m
! logos build ./...
stderr 'slop::discarded_error'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.27

-- m/a/a.lgo --
package a

func AlwaysNil() error {
	return nil
}

-- m/b/b.lgo --
package b

import "example.com/m/a"

func Use() {
	a.AlwaysNil()
}

-- g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- g/g.go --
package g

func AlwaysNil() error {
	return nil
}

-- bad.txt --
package a

import "errors"

var errBad = errors.New("bad")

var fail = true

func AlwaysNil() error {
	if fail {
		return errBad
	}
	return nil
}
